catalog.summary: Import and export jobs with progress.

patternStatus: The WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices index at https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/ has no pattern for a job centre. The family is a native list; the control that opens a job's details follows the Disclosure pattern, every other control follows the Button pattern, the bar is the progressbar role progress-indicator already carries, and a job changing state is a status message under WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.3.

sources.title: Disclosure (Show/Hide) Pattern
sources.settles: The toggle is a button; Enter and Space toggle the details; aria-expanded is true while the details are shown and false otherwise; aria-controls names the details.

sources.title: Button Pattern
sources.settles: Cancel, retry, remove, clear and a download without an href are real buttons; Enter and Space activate them; each carries an accessible name.

sources.title: Understanding SC 4.1.3 Status Messages
sources.settles: A job finishing, failing or being cancelled is announced without moving focus.

reference: Carbon for IBM Products ImportModal and ExportModal, Stripe Report Run and File Link, Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 ingest jobs, HubSpot file imports, Flatfile jobs, PatternFly notification drawer
engine: @slotted/core/import-export-center — jobOutcome, jobControls, jobTone, filterJobs, isActiveJob, fileAvailability, formatJobProgress, estimateFinish and jobNotice; one answer for both bindings
rootRole: region, named by the title message or the consumer's aria-label

roles.views: tablist, held by tabs; the list is its one panel

anatomy.root: a section: the region, the container query and the element a ref returns
anatomy.header: the row above the views: title, and tools
anatomy.title: the heading at level, with the count of active jobs after the words
anatomy.count: the family's own chip: how many jobs are queued or running; absent at zero
anatomy.tools: the family's clear and the consumer's actions, one group that wraps as one so the title keeps its line
anatomy.clear: a button that asks to remove every finished job; absent when none is finished or none is removable
anatomy.actions: the consumer's own controls: upload variant=button to start an import, a button that opens the export dialog
anatomy.views: tabs with the list alone over all, import and export or the consumer's views; absent when there is one view
anatomy.list: a ul named by the title; aria-busy while loading
anatomy.job: one job; carries data-direction, data-status, data-outcome, data-expired and data-expanded
anatomy.visual: the file-kind tile, painted from upload's File kind scale, holding an Icon with the kind's glyph in the scale's foreground; aria-hidden
anatomy.body: the column of a job that shrinks: heading, status, progress, summary and message
anatomy.heading: the job's name and the line of what it is about
anatomy.job-title: the job's name; a link when href is stated
anatomy.meta: direction, format, the file, its size, actor and time; each item a plain span in the line's direction, separated by a drawn dot a wrapped line never starts with
anatomy.file-name: the name and its extension as one run in the name's own direction
anatomy.name: the stem, shrinking to an ellipsis before the extension
anatomy.extension: the last dot and what follows it, which does not shrink
anatomy.time: a time element with the ISO value in datetime
anatomy.status: the mark, the word for the job's state and the consumer's stage
anatomy.mark: an Icon with the status glyph, or spinner while running, in the line's own size, in a column of its own beside status-label
anatomy.stage: the consumer's phase sentence after the word, in the muted voice, after a drawn separator
anatomy.progress: the composed progress-indicator and the text beside it; present while running
anatomy.progress-text: processed of total in the job's unit, the percentage, and the time left when known
anatomy.summary: the counts in one line, once the job has finished
anatomy.message: the sentence about the job: why it failed, why a file cannot be downloaded, when a file expired or expires
anatomy.controls: the job's controls, in the order the table in the design sets
anatomy.download: a slot holding button's control: an a[download] when the file has an href, a button that asks onDownload otherwise
anatomy.retry: a button that asks onRetry; its words say Generate again on an expired export
anatomy.toggle: the Disclosure button that shows and hides the details; its words stay Details in both states, because aria-expanded says which
anatomy.chevron: an Icon with chevron-down in the button's end slot; it turns while the details are shown
anatomy.job-actions: the consumer's own controls for this job
anatomy.remove: an icon button holding an Icon with x, named by a tooltip, that asks to remove a finished job
anatomy.details: the region the toggle shows: counts, files and errors
anatomy.counts: a dl with total, processed, created, updated, skipped and failed, in that order, leaving out what is not stated
anatomy.files: the original file, the result and the error report, each with its own download or its reason
anatomy.file: one row of files: kind word, name, size, availability and its control
anatomy.errors: the composed table of the rows that failed: row, column, value, message
anatomy.errors-note: Showing n of m when the consumer sent a sample
anatomy.more: growing=button: a button that asks onLoadMore; waits while loading
anatomy.empty: the view's empty page, or the consumer's
anatomy.error: status=error: result-state with the control that asks onReload
anatomy.footer: the consumer's footer; absent when not written
anatomy.status-label: the word for the job's state and the consumer's stage, one run that wraps inside its column and never under the mark

wiring.aria-labelledby: on the root and the list, naming the title; on every job control, its own id and the job-title's id, so the name is Download Invoices Q3
wiring.aria-expanded: on the toggle: true while the details are shown
wiring.aria-controls: on the toggle, naming the details; on each tab of the views strip, naming the list
wiring.aria-busy: true on the list while loading
wiring.aria-describedby: on a job's controls, naming the status line
wiring.aria-live: a polite announcement, once per transition, of a shown job reaching another state

statusMeanings.queued: created and waiting to run; a server's Open, planning, scheduled and ready all map here
statusMeanings.running: the server is working on it
statusMeanings.succeeded: the server finished; the outcome is partial when a row failed
statusMeanings.failed: the server gave up; message says why
statusMeanings.canceled: stopped at the reader's or an administrator's word

outcomes.partial: succeeded with counts.failed above nought or errorCount above nought
outcomes.reason: Salesforce calls a job Failed when records were written and not rolled back, and HubSpot shows an Errors column on an import it calls complete. A job with twelve failed rows painted green is the defect a derived outcome prevents: the consumer states counts, the family decides.

statusGlyph.reason: every glyph is a circle or a clock, and a running job draws spinner, the ring every family shows for an indeterminate wait; a triangle is refused in this library, and circle-x is already the failure, so a cancelled job draws the empty circle

controls.expired: download becomes retry, worded Generate again on an export
controls.denied: download is absent and the file's denied sentence is the message
controls.flags: cancelable: false removes cancel, retryable: false removes retry, removable: false removes remove
controls.owner: jobControls in @slotted/core/import-export-center; both bindings render what it returns
controls.toggle: present only when the job has something to show: a count, a file or a failed row (hasDetails)

files.source: the file an import read; downloadable when the consumer states an href
files.result: the file an export produced, or the file an import wrote back
files.errorsFile: the report of the rows that failed
files.expiry: expiresAt is written as an absolute date in every timeFormat: a deadline is a date. Past it the job carries data-expired and the download control leaves
files.permission: denied is the consumer's sentence; the family draws it where the control would be

progress.indeterminate: value absent; the bar is indeterminate and the text says only the stage
progress.remaining: eta from the consumer wins; otherwise estimateFinish reads the updates the family has seen, needs three samples over five seconds, and says nothing below one percent
progress.reason: a bar that speaks every update says nothing; aria-valuenow is on the progressbar for a reader who asks
progress.present: while running; a queued job has no bar, because nothing has started

errors.sample: errorCount above errors.length writes errors-note and the error report's control beside it
errors.block: the table scrolls inside a box of a stated block size, so twelve thousand rows do not become the page
errors.order: the message second: at a narrow width the table scrolls sideways and the words that say what is wrong stay in view

onRemove.from: remove on a job, clear in the header with the reason clear

onDownload.from: download and the files in the details, before the navigation; cancellable

onOpen.from: the job-title link, before its navigation; cancellable

silent: a job that arrives already finished
announcement.reason: WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.3: a job reaching another state reaches assistive technology without taking focus, once per transition

notice.angular: jobToasts(jobs, { toaster, onView }) in an injection context
notice.id: the toast's id is the job's key under the prefix import-export-center:, so the finishing notice replaces the starting one
notice.action: View, which calls onView(key); the consumer navigates to the centre and calls reveal(key)
notice.reason: the operation continues outside the page and the toast only points at the job: it carries no progress, no cancel and no download of its own

keyboard.effect: moves through the header's controls, the views strip's selected tab, then each job's link and controls in the order the jobs are in, then more and the footer
moves back through the same controls
on the toggle: shows or hides the details; on any other control: activates it; on a download link: follows it
on the toggle: shows or hides the details; on a button: activates it
on the views strip: moves between views, as tabs holds it

removal.destination: the same control on the job now in the place of the one that left, then on the job before it, then the list
removal.reason: a reader clearing four failed jobs presses the same key four times

withdrawn.destination: the first control the same job still has, then its title
withdrawn.reason: a job that finishes while focus is on Cancel loses Cancel; focus that fell to the body would make the reader start again from the top of the page

focus.reveal: the handle's reveal(key) asks expanded with programmatic, scrolls the job into view and focuses its title

content.reason: a file name is content the family did not choose; splitName from @slotted/core/upload keeps the extension, the whole name stays in the DOM, and dir=auto reads an Arabic name in its own direction

messagesReason: The status line, the announcer and the toast read the same catalog messages, so they say the same thing about a job. Counts reach a message as numbers, so a plural is the language's and the digits are the locale's; sizes, durations and dates reach it already written. The announcement is one message per transition with `{direction}` chosen inside it, so a language agrees the noun with its verb.

importFromUrl.reason: Carbon ImportModal's URL input; a text-field and a button in the actions slot, with the handler that creates the job

exportDialog.reason: Carbon ExportModal's format and file name; dialog with radio-group and text-field, and the centre receives the job after the choice

columnMapping.reason: Flatfile's mapping and cell review is a data editor; data-grid with editing, or the consumer's importer

transport.reason: polling and webhooks belong to the consumer's store; the family reads jobs and opens no connection

pause.reason: no surveyed server job pauses; upload pauses a transfer, and the job-actions slot holds a server's own pause

bulkSelection.reason: a selection over the list is selection-toolbar's, composed over the same jobs

infiniteScroll.reason: a job history is consulted, not scrolled through; growing=button asks for each page

downloadGlyph.reason: the download control is a button with words; a new glyph changes the token contract, which another lane holds open in this worktree

resolution: the consumer's explicit prop, then the family's defaults provider, then the fallback

open.scope: the set of job keys whose details are shown; a key that leaves jobs leaves the set on the next render

layout.stacked: below 42rem: the tile, and the words with the controls under them; below 22rem the details take the tile's column as well
layout.wide: from 42rem the list is one grid and every job a subgrid of it: tile, name and meta, and the status column with the controls under it, so the columns line up down the list

glyphs: every mark is the Glyph element inside an Icon, drawn by the binding; the stylesheet sizes it through --slotted-icon-size and paints no glyph
